import sys,json,time,resource,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction as F
from itertools import combinations_with_replacement,combinations
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('code').resolve()))
import classification_degenerate_quadric_q4_nil31_I_review as q
start=time.perf_counter();resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(384*1024**2,)*2);resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(40,41))
path='reports/CLASSIFICATION_REGULAR_PENCIL_CI22_REVIEW_V2_20261107.json'
r=json.load(open(path));c=next(c for c in r['all_three_single_eigenvalue_normalizer_cases'] if c['Jordan_partition']=='3+2')
Q=[[F(t) for t in row] for row in c['Q']];N=[[F(t) for t in row] for row in c['N']];Ts=[[[F(t) for t in row] for row in T] for T in c['normalizer_basis']]
R=[[F(j==i+1) for j in range(5)] for i in range(5)]
assert Ts[1]==R and Ts[2]==q.matmul(R,q.matmul(R,R)) and N==q.matmul(R,R)
QQ=q.matmul(Q,N);Qi=q.inverse(Q)
quad=lambda B:q.add(*(q.atom(B[i][j],i,j) for i in range(5) for j in range(5)))
q1=quad(Q);q2=quad(QQ)
assert q1==q.add(q.atom(2,0,4),q.atom(-2,1,3),q.atom(1,2,2))
assert q2==q.add(q.atom(2,2,4),q.atom(-1,3,3))
Cs=[q.matmul(T,Qi) for T in Ts]
source=[]
for f in [q1,q2]:
 for A in Cs: source.append(q.antisymmetric({ij:q.scale(f,A[ij[0]][ij[1]]) for ij in q.PAIRS}))
# Exact sparsefivebracket forms, in frozen basis order CS,CR,CR3.
patterns=[{(0,4):F(1),(1,3):F(-1,2)},{(0,3):F(-1),(1,2):F(1)},{(0,1):F(-1)}]
for i,P in enumerate(source):
 expected=q.antisymmetric({ij:q.scale([q1,q2][i//3],a) for ij,a in patterns[i%3].items()})
 assert all(P.get(ij,{})==expected.get(ij,{}) for ij in q.PAIRS)
paramcols=list(combinations_with_replacement(range(6),2))
Jbase=[q.jacobi(P) for P in source]
assert [str(x) for x in q.jvec(Jbase[0])]==r['nonPoisson_rank4_constant_A_times_nondegenerate_q1_full350']
def addP(P,T):return q.antisymmetric({ij:q.add(P.get(ij,{}),T.get(ij,{})) for ij in q.PAIRS})
def pf(P):
 out={}
 for i in range(5):
  a,b,c,d=[j for j in range(5) if j!=i]
  t=q.add(q.mul(P.get((a,b),{}),P.get((c,d),{})),q.scale(q.mul(P.get((a,c),{}),P.get((b,d),{})),-1),q.mul(P.get((a,d),{}),P.get((b,c),{})))
  out=q.add(out,q.scale(q.mul(q.atom(1,i),t),(-1)**i))
 return out
Fbase=[pf(P) for P in source]
Jcols=[];Fcols=[];Jpolys=[]
for i,j in paramcols:
 if i==j:Jc=Jbase[i];Fc=Fbase[i]
 else:
  P=addP(source[i],source[j]);J=q.jacobi(P)
  Jc={quad:q.add(J[quad],q.scale(Jbase[i][quad],-1),q.scale(Jbase[j][quad],-1)) for quad in q.QUADS}
  Fc=q.add(pf(P),q.scale(Fbase[i],-1),q.scale(Fbase[j],-1))
 Jcols.append(q.jvec(Jc));Fcols.append(Fc);Jpolys.append(Jc)
# Hand-derived full1234 polynomial, not just two values.
E={
 (0,0):q.scale(q.mul(q.atom(1,4,2),q1),-1),
 (0,1):q.scale(q.mul(q.atom(1,4,3),q1),-2),
 (1,1):q.scale(q.mul(q.atom(1,4,4),q1),-2),
 (0,3):q.scale(q.mul(q.atom(1,4,2),q2),-1),
 (1,3):q.scale(q.mul(q.atom(1,4,3),q2),-1),
 (0,4):q.scale(q.mul(q.atom(1,4,3),q2),-1),
 (1,4):q.scale(q.mul(q.atom(1,4,4),q2),-2)
}
assert all(J[(1,2,3,4)]==E.get(ij,{}) for ij,J in zip(paramcols,Jpolys))
witness=[]
for mon,pair,coef in [((1,0,1,0,2),(0,0),F(-2)),((1,0,0,0,3),(1,1),F(-4))]:
 row=q.ROWS.index(((1,2,3,4),mon));values=[col[row] for col in Jcols]
 assert all(v==(coef if pp==pair else 0) for pp,v in zip(paramcols,values))
 witness.append({'original350_row_index':row,'quadruple':[1,2,3,4],'monomial_exponents':mon,'parameter_square_index':pair[0],'coefficient':str(coef),'full21_row':[str(v) for v in values]})
# FullactualPfaffian has exactly -x2*f²/2-x3*f*g-x4*g², h disappears.
f={0:q1,3:q2};g={1:q1,4:q2}
expectedF={}
for ij in paramcols:
 i,j=ij;mult=F(1 if i==j else 2)
 vv=q.add(q.scale(q.mul(q.atom(1,2),q.mul(f.get(i,{}),f.get(j,{}))),-mult/2),q.scale(q.mul(q.atom(1,4),q.mul(g.get(i,{}),g.get(j,{}))),-mult))
 cross=q.add(q.mul(f.get(i,{}),g.get(j,{})),q.mul(f.get(j,{}),g.get(i,{}))) if i!=j else q.mul(f.get(i,{}),g.get(j,{}))
 vv=q.add(vv,q.scale(q.mul(q.atom(1,3),cross),-1))
 expectedF[ij]=vv
assert all(p==expectedF[ij] for ij,p in zip(paramcols,Fcols))
mon5=q.monomials(5);Fp=[[p.get(e+(0,0,0),F(0)) for p in Fcols] for e in mon5]
forced=[(ij,p) for ij,p in zip(paramcols,Fcols) if ij[0] not in (0,1) and ij[1] not in (0,1) and p]
assert [ij for ij,p in forced]==[(3,3),(3,4),(4,4)]
q2sq=q.mul(q2,q2)
for ij,co in [((3,3),q.atom(F(-1,2),2)),((3,4),q.atom(-1,3)),((4,4),q.atom(-1,4))]:
 assert expectedF[ij]==q.mul(q2sq,co)
encode=lambda v:[{'index':i,'value':str(x)} for i,x in enumerate(v) if x]
out={
 'task_id':'E_reduced_nonnormal','all_passed':True,
 'canonical_record':'3+2 in frozen CLASSIFICATION_REGULAR_PENCIL_CI22_REVIEW_V2_20261107.json',
 'source_parameter_order':['a0','b0','c0','a1','b1','c1'],
 'source_basis_order':['q1CS','q1CR','q1CR3','q2CS','q2CR','q2CR3'],
 'q1':'2*x0*x4-2*x1*x3+x2^2','q2':'2*x2*x4-x3^2',
 'canonicalQ_N_basis_exactly_match_frozen_record':True,
 'sparse_fivebracket_identity_exact':True,
 'all150x6_source_sparse_columns':[encode(q.vec(P)) for P in source],
 'source_coordinate_order':'x0,x1,x2,x3,x4',
 'quadratic_parameter_monomial_columns':[list(ij) for ij in paramcols],
 'all350_original_Jacobi_source_restriction_sparse_columns':[encode(col) for col in Jcols],
 'original350_row_order':[{'quadruple':list(quad),'exponents':list(e)} for quad,e in q.ROWS],
 'old_frozenq1CS_full350_exactly_reproduced':True,
 'full1234_hand_formula_allcoefficients_verified':True,
 'full1234_formula':'-x4*((a0*x2+b0*x3)*(a0*q1+a1*q2)+(a0*x3+2*b0*x4)*(b0*q1+b1*q2))',
 'two_necessary_original_rows':witness,
 'all_complex_reduced_Poisson_points_force_a0_b0_zero':True,
 'full126_actualPfaffian_sparse_rows':[encode(row) for row in Fp],
 'full126_Pfaffian_monomial_order':[list(e) for e in mon5],
 'whole_actualPfaffian_formula':'-x2*(a0*q1+a1*q2)^2/2-x3*(a0*q1+a1*q2)*(b0*q1+b1*q2)-x4*(b0*q1+b1*q2)^2',
 'forced_support_actualPfaffian':'-q2^2*(a1^2*x2/2+a1*b1*x3+b1^2*x4)',
 'irreducible_actual_quintic_source_empty':True,
 'rank4_iff_a1_b1_not_both_zero_on_forced_support':True,
 'tangent_H_to_rank3Q_dual_identity':'2*(a1^2/2)*b1^2-(a1*b1)^2=0',
 'rank4_whole_redirect':'accepted fullrank3 H+2Q coverage, all tangent vertex-containing configurations included',
 'a1_b1_zero_complement':'actualPf0, rank<=2, use priorfullrank<=2coverage',
 'remaining_Jacobi_constraints_solved_or_assumed_zero':False,
 'scheme_nilpotent_thickness_classified':False,
 'new_source_profile_minor_GB_jet_or_150column_operator':False,
 'seconds':time.perf_counter()-start,'maximum_RSS_KiB':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,
 'input_sha256':{p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [path,'code/classification_degenerate_quadric_q4_nil31_I_review.py']},
 'inline_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),
 'exact_helper_source_bytes':Path('code/classification_degenerate_quadric_q4_nil31_I_review.py').read_text()
}
p=Path('reports/CLASSIFICATION_CI22_NIL32_RANKZERO_ACTUAL_FACTOR_20261108.json');assert not p.exists();p.write_text(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:out[k] for k in ['all_passed','seconds','maximum_RSS_KiB','two_necessary_original_rows','irreducible_actual_quintic_source_empty']},ensure_ascii=False))
